description.value: Tiramisu Republic is a dessert cafe located at 4611 Kingsway in Burnaby's Metrotown neighbourhood, operating out of a space previously occupied by Ricey Yogurt. Specializing in dessert cuisine, it sits along a major arterial corridor with good transit and cycling access through Burnaby. Touring cyclists passing through Metrotown will find it a convenient stop for a sweet break.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 36m; rack (3 spaces) at 36m; rack (4 spaces) at 68m. Total: 10 spaces.

All amenity and business detail fields therefore rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms a dessert cafe at 4611 Kingsway Burnaby with outdoor_seating explicitly tagged 'no'; the was:name tag 'Ricey Yogurt' indicates a prior business at this address.
concerns: Website URL is an Instagram profile that requires login — fetched content returned only generic Instagram pages with no business-specific information; all amenity fields are unverifiable.
